headline: MIC Electronics receives trading approval for preferential shares
hook: Over 56 million new shares now tradable
summary: MIC Electronics Limited has secured trading approval from both the BSE and NSE for 5,68,73,418 shares. These shares were previously allotted on a preferential basis. This approval allows the newly issued equity to be traded on the stock exchanges.
why_it_matters: Increased share supply may impact stock liquidity and price
